summary: Keeps Judgement of Wisdom on the boss for the raid.
rotation: The spell power on-use trinket at the pull, then held for the execute phase when that loses no use; Goblin Sapper Charge on cooldown
Judgement of Wisdom at the pull, for the duty, then Seal of Command. Melee hits refresh it, so it is judged again only if it drops
Seal of Command when it's down, or with 10s or less left when Consecration, Holy Shock and Holy Strike are all more than a GCD away
Divine Favor when Holy Shock is ready
Hammer of Wrath under 20% boss health, when instant or right after a swing
Exorcism on cooldown (only against Undead and Demons)
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Takes Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed), a must-have talent.
Infusion of Light, Oath of Light and Turn Evil do nothing for damage on a boss, so this build gives up Consecrated Ground, Vindication, Reverence and Healing Light for healing and utility.

Grayston swaps to the Manual Crowd Pummeler for its 30s of haste at the pull and every 3 min after. The sim can't swap in a weapon with a use effect yet, so this preset keeps its main weapon and skips the Pummeler.
Wears the report's Phase 0 Shock gear, not Grayston's own set, so the gap to Ret Shock comes from talents and rotation alone.

Two-Handed Weapon Specialization raises all Holy damage as well as physical, and Vengeance stacks up to 5 times, as the November 2 development notes announce. Client 1.60.1.70753 still has Physical only and 3 stacks; the sim takes the notes' values until a hotfix or client build says otherwise (standards 37).
Unverified: Holy Strike's flat bonus is added before its weapon damage percent, as the client data says.
The top Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% of DPS).
No filler explosive, because each 1s cast resets the swing.
notes: Grayston's "2H Shockadin" Phase 1 pre-raid build (his video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XuUccSoLa0I, spreadsheet "Grayston - WoW Forever - Pre-Raid BIS" and rotation file shock_mcp_sor_2.siml). Talents 21/0/30 decoded from the video's talent screenshot against the October 30 tree. Request: paladin__level_60_shock_ret with raid debuff judgementOfWisdom removed (as paladin__level_60_shock_ret-duty-wisdom) with talentsString 05005210222101--0523300120131135, Retribution Aura and the rotation translated from his .siml, the same edits mksettings -apl would make. Gear: the report's level60_phase0_ret_shock set, so the comparison with Ret Shock isolates talents and rotation (standards 43: every DPS preset wears a Phase 0 list; his own set has Destiny, which is over the Phase 0 gold line). Rotation differences from his file: no Manual Crowd Pummeler swap (the sim registers a swap weapon's use effect only when it starts equipped, and has no APL value for the active swap set), so Seal of Righteousness never comes up; presets start in melee range, so his move-to-melee sequence becomes a one-time opener; the trinket and Goblin Sapper lines are the report's; Exorcism's undead/demon clause in the reseal check is left out (the boss is neither). His own set (Stalwart Helm, Nacreous Shell Necklace, Soulforge pieces, Arcanoweave Cloak, Champion's Legplates, Channeler's Ring, Don Julio's Band, Hand of Justice, Blackhand's Breadth, Libram of Law, Destiny, Manual Crowd Pummeler swap) is not simmed.
